consent.text: I've read the privacy notice and I consent to the processing of my data to manage the booking, including any allergies I choose to share (Art. 9 GDPR).

terms.intro: For larger groups we ask for a deposit of {{amount}} per person. When it applies, you'll get a payment link after you submit the form — the table is confirmed as soon as the payment arrives.
terms.ifYouCome: If you come, we deduct it from the bill.
terms.ifYouCancelEarly: If you cancel at least 24 hours ahead, we refund it in full.
terms.ifYouCancelLate: If you cancel later or don't show up, we keep it.
terms.why1: A table booked and left empty means food already bought, staff already on shift, and other guests we had to turn away. The confirmatory deposit (Art. 1385 of the Italian Civil Code) is how restaurants protect themselves from no-shows.
terms.why2: To cancel or move your booking, message or call us: within 24 hours, you lose nothing.
